checks.detail: First claim/run (evidence/runs/pcxt) used the 31 Oct sequence with no key press. The empty-drive frame (+8 s, before insert-start) showed GLaBIOS mid-POST. The insert was accepted and unit 0 went ready. Every later frame showed 'Disk Boot Fail. You monster. Press the Any Key' for 150 s, with no prompt. The frames do not show whether the boot attempt came before or after unit 0 went ready. Classified as harness: at the 31 Oct build commit 0fdae134 the core README said 'The guest stays in reset until the initial image is physically written and committed'. The current README says 'Inserting a disk into a running guest does not reset it or automatically restart its boot' (introduced before this PR's merge-base 4f1b3975). PR #2097 changes no file under cores/fes-pcxt (git diff 4f1b3975..0c16ab4d lists only identity/producer/test/docs files). Kit was restored and released FREE before attempt 2.
